hints.title: Ordered Triplet Objective
hints.text: Maximize (nums[i] - nums[j]) * nums[k] subject to i < j < k. If all values are non-positive, return 0.

hints.title: Running Extrema Tracking
hints.text: As index k advances, maintain the maximum value of nums[i] seen so far and the maximum difference (nums[i] - nums[j]) seen so far.

hints.title: Online Update
hints.text: At each step, update candidate answer with max_diff * nums[k], then update max_diff with max_i - nums[k], and finally update max_i with nums[k].

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass tracking prefix maximums and differences.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^3) triple loop works for n <= 100 but is suboptimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Achieve O(n) time using running max_i and max_diff.
